limitation: molframe's tm_score fits by reweighting a correspondence-preserving superposition, and TM-align maximises over superpositions with a residue-level dynamic program that can also re-pair residues. The two agree exactly for a rigid displacement and to 1e-5 for small non-rigid noise, and the kernel is never below the plain least-squares fit. On motion that swings part of the chain past another it reads about 0.04 lower (hinge) and 0.015 lower (tail) than TM-align, which is the residue-repairing search it cannot reach from a fixed correspondence.
representation: C-alpha trace of the protein, one point per residue
